scripts.dev: npm run db:push && npm run dev:server
scripts.build: npm run dep-check && npm run build:user && npm run build:admin && npm run build:server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @joyjoin/shared && npm run typecheck -w @joyjoin/user-client && npm run typecheck -w @joyjoin/admin-client && npm run typecheck -w mini-program && npm run typecheck -w @joyjoin/server
scripts.check:clients: npm run typecheck -w @joyjoin/shared && npm run typecheck -w @joyjoin/user-client && npm run typecheck -w @joyjoin/admin-client && npm run typecheck -w mini-program
scripts.check:full: npm run guardrails && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @joyjoin/shared && npm run lint -w @joyjoin/user-client && npm run lint -w @joyjoin/admin-client && npm run lint -w @joyjoin/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @joyjoin/shared && npm run test -w @joyjoin/user-client && npm run test -w @joyjoin/admin-client && npm run test -w @joyjoin/server
scripts.start: npm run db:migrate && npm run start -w @joyjoin/server
scripts.guardrails: node scripts/check-guardrails.mjs && node --test scripts/check-guardrails.test.mjs && node scripts/check-brand-colors.mjs && node scripts/design-audit.mjs
scripts.db:status: npm run db:journal-check && npm run db:verify
